summary: iPhone #1776: restore cached icons without blocking launch input
manual: On the published 0.1.30 build (202611020551), reproduce feedback #1776 on a physical iPhone 11 with a matching saved-tab, sync, extension and icon-cache profile. No diagnostic/profile was supplied; simulator timings do not establish A13 speed or reporter acceptance.

Run Phone/scripts/launch-speed-check.sh BASE in an exclusive display farm job with --needs ios-sim,xcodegen --exclude-host main --exclude-host m4. Read the exact-base expected assertion failure, cache main-queue delay, all candidate test results, and both start-page launch/resume samples. Do not treat missing tests, build errors or simulator failures as the expected baseline failure.
After clearing browsing data during cache restoration, cached icons stay cleared. A newer fetched icon survives an overlapping restore; corrupt cached files do not prevent valid icons appearing.
